scope: independent scientific and community review PREPARATION, no independent review performed

geographicalAggregateContext.source: DWP official local administrative model for 2023/24, published 2025-10-30

publicSubmissionMethod: Public methodology-only GitHub issue #19 or PR, with consent to public non-sensitive publication; no private case data or participant recruitment

reviewChallenges.title: Population, statutory eligibility and household versus benefit-unit mismatch
reviewChallenges.question: What is the actual independent benefit-unit eligibility definition and nonrecipient baseline sampling frame?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: independently verified participant eligibility; legal entitlement rules and dates; nonreceipt baseline

reviewChallenges.title: First paid Pension Credit as primary outcome
reviewChallenges.question: Can linked, verified first payments and unknown/pending/denied cases be recorded lawfully at fixed follow-up?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: verified first payment mechanism; de-duplication and paid/awarded distinction

reviewChallenges.title: Independent additionality versus Our Newham Money/LIFT
reviewChallenges.question: Does any extra HPI service answer a question not already solved by Newham Council and DWP?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: credible existing-programme evaluation audit and incremental intervention theory

reviewChallenges.title: Comparator, assignment, estimand and nonwithholding
reviewChallenges.question: Can a defensible comparison avoid denying legal entitlements or diverting existing support?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: approved comparator/assignment, ITT-or-alternative estimand and spillover model

reviewChallenges.title: Missingness, attrition and precision
reviewChallenges.question: What prespecified loss mechanisms and sensitivity bounds are required; is a sample/power analysis defensible?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: source feasibility, baseline rate under same definitions, missingness and effect threshold

reviewChallenges.title: Bias and falsification
reviewChallenges.question: What selection and calendar confounders, negative controls and pretrend falsification rules would invalidate any causal claim?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: bias graph or explicit causal assumptions and tests for chosen design

reviewChallenges.title: Equity, disability, language and nonparticipant harms
reviewChallenges.question: Which populations are systematically excluded or burdened, and how is small-cell safety achieved?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: human community accessibility assessment and disclosure controls

reviewChallenges.title: Implementation economics and harms
reviewChallenges.question: How will partner and claimant time costs, harms and null/negative incremental outcomes be recorded separately?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: audited operational costs and incident/safeguarding plan

reviewChallenges.title: Local instrument validity and invariance
reviewChallenges.question: Are autonomy and hardship surveys appropriate, translated, reliable and comparable in Newham?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: validated instruments and safeguarded local testing or exclusion

reviewChallenges.title: Pre-specified outcomes and multiplicity
reviewChallenges.question: Can one primary measure and analysis hierarchy be registered in advance with defensible power?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: protocol version, estimand, follow-up and prespecified analysis

reviewChallenges.title: Controller, ethics, data rights and independence
reviewChallenges.question: Who is legally accountable for personal records and independently approves method, data protection and ethics?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: qualified legal/privacy/ethics approvals and actual independent reviewers

reviewChallenges.title: Stop decision and review dissent
reviewChallenges.question: What negative findings should require stopping or choosing a purely descriptive study?
reviewChallenges.requiredEvidence: documented human-governed no-go decision and dissent

negativeFeasibility.rationale: No lawful independently verified eligible baseline cohort or confirmed first payments for HPI-B-01; insufficient evidence of additionality beyond existing services; no independent methods, ethics, community, sponsor or privacy permissions.
negativeFeasibility.legitimateAlternative: Publish a descriptive feasibility result or stop without starting a duplicative intervention

sourceQualityWarning: Technical reproducibility is not peer review; this manifest is author-prepared and dated, not an external review or grant of permission.
